visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands holds a silver tray containing two sea bass heads and two fillets. The scene is set in a brightly lit kitchen with a wooden countertop and various kitchen tools in the background. (2) The hands sprinkle salt over the fish parts in the tray to prepare them. The background remains consistent, showing a modern kitchen setting with soft, natural lighting. (3) On a yellow cutting board, an onion is sliced into thin strips with a large chef's knife. The camera focuses on the rhythmic movement of the hands and the blade. (4) Scallions are chopped into segments and minced, followed by slicing pieces of ginger and crushing garlic cloves. The movements are focused on the ingredients and the knife work. (5) A stainless steel pot is heated on an induction stove. A small amount of water is added to test the temperature, and then oil is poured into the hot pot. (6) Fish bones and heads are placed into the pot using metal tongs. They are fried until golden brown on one side, then flipped to sear the other side. (7) Sliced ginger is added to a clear spot in the pot, followed by garlic and scallion segments. The ingredients are stirred together with the fried fish parts using a wooden spatula. (8) White pepper and salt are sprinkled over the mixture, and then onion slices are added. The chef continues to stir the ingredients to combine the flavors. (9) A splash of wine is poured into the pot, followed by a large amount of hot water. The liquid begins to boil, and foam is skimmed off the surface with a slotted spoon. (10) The soup continues to boil uncovered for 30 minutes, gradually turning into a creamy milky white color. Steam rises from the pot as it simmers. (11) The finished soup is poured through a fine-mesh strainer into a large metal bowl to remove the solid ingredients. The solids are pressed with a spatula to extract all the juice. (12) The clear, milky soup is poured into a large white ceramic pot. The video concludes with text overlays promoting the next episode and social media accounts.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 準備一條新鮮鱸魚 可以請攤商老闆幫忙處理去骨. (2) [Subtitle]: 將魚清洗乾淨 擦乾水分. (3) [Subtitle]: 灑適量的鹽 幫助魚骨去腥... (4) [Subtitle]: 先放一旁靜置10分鐘出水. (5) [Subtitle]: 魚排先放到冰箱. (6) [Subtitle]: 將洋蔥切成絲. (7) [Subtitle]: 兩株青蔥切成段. (8) [Subtitle]: 再切一些蔥花備用. (9) [Subtitle]: 薑片數片. (10) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍製開來. (11) [Subtitle]: 辛香料就這些. (12) [Subtitle]: 將魚滲出來的水擦乾 避免煎魚的時候噴油 (也可去除多餘鹽分). (13) [Subtitle]: 魚肉的部分，先冷藏備用... (14) [Subtitle]: 中火熱鍋約3分鐘. (15) [Subtitle]: 用一點水測試一下鍋溫. (16) [Subtitle]: 看到鍋裡的水珠會在鍋面上「跳動」或「滾動」表示鍋子達到適合煎炒的溫度. (17) [Subtitle]: 先關火一下，再倒入油. (18) [Subtitle]: 再開中火加熱. (19) [Subtitle]: 先放入魚骨進來煎. (20) [Subtitle]: 魚頭. (21) [Subtitle]: 先讓一面煎出焦香 再翻面. (22) [Subtitle]: 魚頭的部分也煎出焦香了. (23) [Subtitle]: 魚骨兩面都煎出焦香就可以了！ (24) [Subtitle]: 挪一個位子 稍微煎一下薑片. (25) [Subtitle]: 放入蒜頭、青蔥. (26) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下. (27) [Subtitle]: 灑入兩撮白胡椒、一點鹽調味. (28) [Subtitle]: 翻炒出香氣. (29) [Subtitle]: 放入洋蔥絲. (30) [Subtitle]: 稍微翻炒一下. (31) [Subtitle]: 大概炒勻就可以了. (32) [Subtitle]: 鍋底先嗆入一些酒 增加香氣. (33) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下 並且刮起鍋底的焦香. (34) [Subtitle]: 加入約1200ml的熱水. (35) [Subtitle]: 把湯煮滾. (36) [Subtitle]: 邊煮邊撈一下浮沫. (37) [Subtitle]: 中途如果水分蒸發 可以補足水量. (38) [Subtitle]: 不要蓋蓋子，小滾的狀態 持續滾30分鐘. (39) [Subtitle]: 煮到湯呈乳白色 就差不多了❤️ (40) [Subtitle]: 把湯過濾出來. (41) [Subtitle]: 過濾掉渣渣. (42) [Subtitle]: 渣渣擠出更多的湯汁. (43) [Subtitle]: 倒進來 不要浪費了... (44) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，超級好喝的「鱸魚高湯」就完成啦～❤️😊 (45) [Subtitle]: 別忘了下一集，好喝又健康的「鱸魚蘿蔔湯」❤️😊😊 (46) [Subtitle]: 不要忘記收看喔❤️😊😊😊 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen
